text: Trojan beaconing to a command-and-control server detected on laptop host-17.
Cryptominer process found running on build server ci-3, CPU at 100% for two days.
EDR blocked a malicious macro but the payload already executed on host-88.
Workstation host-5 is scanning the internal network and spreading a worm.
User jbianchi entered her password on a fake Microsoft login page from a phishing email.
Impossible travel: account lverdi logged in from Milan and from Singapore within 10 minutes.
The API key of the deploy bot was pushed to a public GitHub repository.
Password spraying succeeded on the account of the receptionist, mailbox rules were created.
A CSV with 12,000 customer names, emails and home addresses was uploaded to an unknown server.
An employee emailed the payroll spreadsheet with salaries and tax codes to the wrong external address.
The S3 bucket with patients' medical reports was publicly readable for a week.
Attacker used the stolen password of mrossi to log into host-42 and install a backdoor.
Infostealer malware on host-9 exfiltrated the saved browser passwords of user gneri.
Compromised server db-2 sent the customer table with names and phone numbers to the attacker.
Weekly vulnerability scan completed: no new findings.
Firewall rule change approved and applied by the network team as planned.
